decision_rule.statement: Block the change when any case fails all 3 of its trials, or when the share of cases passing every trial falls below the lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of the previous results for the same scope.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a criterion whose "more than" had been flipped to "less than" as word for word.

cases.expected: The three criteria are copied word for word, with their comparisons ("more than", "or less") and amounts unchanged.
